tool.name: Wonky
tool.description: Calculate mean quality, length, and GC content for each read from a FASTQ file

data.name: output
data.label: Read Quality, Length, and GC Content

tool.help:
### Tool Description This tool processes a FASTQ file and calculates the following metrics for each read: - **Read_ID**: Unique identifier for each read. - **Quality**: Mean quality score for each read. - **Length**: Length of the sequence. - **GC_content**: Percentage of G and C nucleotides in the sequence.
#### Output The tool generates a tabular file with the following columns: - Read_ID - Mean Quality - Length - GC Content
#### Optional Parameters - *Include Summary Statistics*: Include overall metrics such as average read quality, total length, and mean GC content.
#### Usage Instructions 1. Upload a FASTQ file to Galaxy. 2. Run this tool with the desired parameters. 3. Download the tabular output for downstream analysis.
#### Dependencies - Python 3.8 or later - Compatible with FASTQ files in the `fastqsanger` format.
